name: service-examples
goal: Service detail pages show source-true construction and representative instance-method examples for supported service behaviors, with a clear missing-documentation state and revision-correct links.

evidence: Acceptance criteria cover service examples, method-scoped contracts including initialize, separate class-level errors, and compatibility with older methodless contracts.
Service detail Examples and per-method Contract rendering are implemented with fixtures for AgentActivityService and OrderFeed.
Reports package unit suite passed 650 tests; focused service browser regressions passed 4 cases across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Harness units check passed. Reports format, typecheck, lint, 650 unit tests, build, and audit passed. Full E2E was omitted at Daniel request.
